assertions.description: Iterator.zip is a function (Chrome 153 developer trial behind the JavaScript-harmony flag).
zip over two equal-length iterables yields position-aligned arrays.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof Iterator === 'undefined' || typeof Iterator.zip !== 'function') return false; const r = Iterator.zip([[0,1,2],[3,4,5]]).toArray(); return JSON.stringify(r) === '[[0,3],[1,4],[2,5]]'; })()

assertions.description: zip of zero sources is an already-completed iterator (design-space decision), yielding an empty array.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof Iterator === 'undefined' || typeof Iterator.zip !== 'function') return false; return Iterator.zip([]).toArray().length === 0; })()

assertions.description: Default mode is shortest: mismatched lengths truncate to the shortest source.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof Iterator === 'undefined' || typeof Iterator.zip !== 'function') return false; return Iterator.zip([['a','b','c'],[1,2,3,4,5]]).toArray().length === 3; })()

assertions.description: mode longest continues to the longest source, filling exhausted sources with their per-source padding value.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof Iterator === 'undefined' || typeof Iterator.zip !== 'function') return false; const r = Iterator.zip([['a'],[1,2]], { mode: 'longest', padding: ['P', null] }).toArray(); return r.length === 2 && r[1][0] === 'P' && r[1][1] === 2; })()

assertions.description: mode strict throws when sources complete after different numbers of yields.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof Iterator === 'undefined' || typeof Iterator.zip !== 'function') return false; try { Iterator.zip([['a'],[1,2]], { mode: 'strict' }).toArray(); return false; } catch (e) { return true; } })()

assertions.description: zipKeyed yields objects whose keys mirror the input object's keys.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof Iterator === 'undefined' || typeof Iterator.zipKeyed !== 'function') return false; const r = Iterator.zipKeyed({ a: [0,1], b: [2,3] }).toArray(); return r.length === 2 && r[0].a === 0 && r[0].b === 2 && r[1].a === 1 && r[1].b === 3; })()
